Converted the Tailwind
//

tree to React Native View + AppText + StyleSheet primitives using the existing ../../../components/ui/AppText and ../../../theme/tokens. space-y-4 -> container rowGap 16; flex gap-3 pl-6 row -> flexDirection row + paddingLeft 24 (the dot/connector are absolute so the in-flow content is the only flex child); the connector left-[11px] top-6 h-full is reproduced as an absolute top:24/bottom:-20 span at left:11 so the line bridges the inter-row gap and meets the next dot; the dot keeps left:0 top:4 22x22 rounded-full border-2 centring; text-sm/text-xs map to fontSize 14/12 with leading-5/leading-4 lineHeights.

Colour mapping uses dark-mode Tailwind variants (native shell is always dark): dark:text-gray-100 -> colors.textPrimary (title), var(--text-muted) -> colors.textMuted (time/subtitle and the default currentColor inner dot + icon tint). Structural grays are pinned to literal Tailwind hexes so the bubble keeps masking the connector: dark:bg-gray-700 #374151 (connector), dark:bg-gray-900 #111827 (dot fill), dark:border-gray-600 #4b5563 (default ring). When item.color is supplied it drives the ring, the icon glyph tint, and the inner-dot fill exactly like the web style={{borderColor,color}} + backgroundColor override.

ReactNode handling: title/subtitle/icon may be strings, numbers, or already-rendered elements. String/number nodes are wrapped in AppText so the web text styling (font-medium title, muted subtitle, tinted icon glyph) is preserved; element nodes pass through unchanged (wrapped in a flexShrink View for the title/subtitle slots to keep the baseline title/time split and avoid RN 'text must be inside <Text>' errors). The subtitle uses the same truthy guard as the web `item.subtitle && (...)`.

No DOM-only modules, lucide-react, react-i18next, recharts, leaflet, or web UI components are imported (the source had none); the web-only cn() class merge is dropped and `className` is accepted but inert, with native `style`/`testID` added for parity ergonomics. Source has no i18n, API, or unit-conversion concerns, so none were introduced. Verified via cd apps/native; npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
